correctness.rationale: Every 2k+2 consecutive vertices split into k+1 opposite pairs. Selecting k+3 forces two complete opposite pairs, which induce P4; hence at most k+2 per block. Periodic 1^(k+2)0^k choices reach the bound. The saturated suffix forces its preceding k zeros, yielding backward uniqueness when r=k+2; shifting/reversing witnesses show nonuniqueness otherwise. Independent exhaustive induced-P4 subset enumeration checked n<=11 and 1<=k<=6 (66 pairs). The symbolic window proof covers all integers, including n<=k+2.
